ios.desc:
Featured by Apple, TechCrunch, and more!

Caleido is a free, simple, and beautifully re-imagined calendar and task app. With usability and simplicity in mind, Caleido’s uniquely customizable interface along with map and weather integration helps you easily manage your life. 

With Caleido you can:

∙ Instantly sync with all your existing iOS calendars (iCloud, Gmail, Yahoo, Exchange, Hotmail, AOL, and more).
∙ Manage events, tasks, and frequent locations with day, timeline, week, month, list, location and task views. Full map, contact, location, and weather integration keep you one step ahead. 
∙ Customize your experience with iPhone 7 (Silver, Space Gray, Gold), iPhone SE (Blue, Green, Red), and seasonal themes!
